blocks.prompt: 12. Find the value of \(k\) if the lines \(x + y - 4 = 0\), \(2x - y + 1 = 0\) and \(kx + 2y - 10 = 0\) are concurrent.
blocks.explanation:
Teen lines hain aur teesri line mein ek na-maloom coefficient \(k\) hai.
Lines concurrent hain, yani Theorem 3 ke mutabiq coefficients ka determinant zero hai.
Yeh shart \(k\) ki ek equation de degi.
Plan: determinant \(= 0\), \(k\) hal karna, aur meeting point se tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x + y - 4 = 0\), \(2x - y + 1 = 0\), \(kx + 2y - 10 = 0\) concurrent hain.
Maloom karna: \(k\).
Tareeqa: Theorem 3; determinant ko zero ke barabar rakh kar \(k\) hal karna.
Socho: k sirf teesri line mein hai, is liye pehli do lines ka meeting point bilkul pakka hai; teesri line ko bas us point se guzarna hai.

Determinant banayein
\[\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 1 & -4 \\ 2 & -1 & 1 \\ k & 2 & -10 \end{vmatrix} = 0\]
Kyun: concurrent lines ka determinant zero hona zaroori hai; is se \(k\) ki ek equation milegi.
Har row ek line ke \(a, b, c\) hain; teesri row mein \(k\) pehli jagah par aaya kyunke woh \(x\) ka coefficient hai.

Pehli row ke saath expand karein
\[1(10 - 2) - 1(-20 - k) - 4(4 + k) = 0\]
\[8 + 20 + k - 16 - 4k = 0\]
\[12 - 3k = 0\]
Kyun: pehli row par signs \(+, -, +\); har \(2 \times 2\) minor \(ps - qr\) hai.
Dhyan dein: beech wale term ka minus sign aksar choot jata hai.

Hal karein
\[3k = 12\]
\[k = 4\]
Kyun: yeh \(k\) ki seedhi linear equation hai.
Doosra tareeqa bhi isi nateeje par pohanchta hai: pehli do lines ka point (1, 3) teesri line mein rakho, to k + 6 - 10 = 0, yani k = 4.

Tasdeeq:
Pehli do lines \((1, 3)\) (dono jama karein: \(3x - 3 = 0\)) par milti hain. Teesri line mein rakhein:
\[4(1) + 2(3) - 10 = 0\]
Teesri line bhi isi point se guzarti hai, jawab sahi hai.
